{{short description|American mathematician}}
{{use mdy dates|date=August 2021}}

'''Adolfo J. Rumbos''' is an American mathematician whose research interests include [[nonlinear analysis]] and [[Boundary value problem|boundary value problems]].<ref name="Official" /> He is the Joseph N. Fiske Professor of Mathematics at [[Pomona College]] in [[Claremont, California]].<ref name="Official">{{cite web |title=Adolfo Rumbos |date=June 2015 |url=https://www.pomona.edu/directory/people/adolfo-j-rumbos |publisher=Pomona College |access-date=26 August 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

Rumbos is a graduate of [[Humboldt State University]].<ref name="Official" /> He completed his Ph.D. in 1989 from the [[University of California, Santa Cruz]] with the dissertation ''Applications of the Leray-Schauder topological Degree to Boundary Value Problems for Semilinear Differential Equations'' supervised by Edward M. Landesman.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|1536}}</ref>
